instruction.text: Sarah is taking the train from Manchester to Birmingham. Use the train timetable to answer the following questions.

atoms.a: How long is the train ride from Manchester to Birmingham?
How long does it take to get to Stoke-on-Trent from Stockport?
How long does it take to get to Stafford from Macclesfield?
In Birmingham, Sarah is taking a connecting train to Cardiff. The train leaves at 15:47. How long does she have to wait?

instruction.text: When she arrives in Cardiff, Sarah takes a bus to her aunt’s house in Barry. Use the bus timetable to answer the following questions.

atoms.a: How long is the bus ride from Cardiff to Barry?
How long does it take to get to Wallston Castle from Knightswell?
The bus is delayed by 480 seconds because of traffic. What time does Sarah arrive in Barry?
